note: ADR 1014, the review's fourth probe: a function assigned to another member of a const object literal's holder (after the literal, borrowed from another object, or through `this` in the literal's own method) hands its receiver to Object.assign / Object.defineProperty and replaces the member the timer is handed; the timer then calls a function that reads its `this`. The checker withdraws the slots (REACTIVE_WRITE_IN_OWNED_SCOPE at set(2) is covered by an uncertifiable row, not a violation; the first three were violations on the build 3f33a1a15)
